headline: Executive order creates a federal task force to study the United States Postal System.
what_it_does: This order sets up a task force within the federal government to look at the U.S. Postal System. Based on the title, the group's job is to review how the postal system works. No summary was provided, so the specific duties, members, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. Postal Service and its workers
who_it_affects.how: The Postal Service's operations would be the subject of the task force's review.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agency officials named to the task force
who_it_affects.how: They would be assigned to carry out the review.
